question: Which neighborhoods are completely inside the rectangular map window that covers central Manhattan from about longitude -74.02, latitude 40.70 in the southwest corner to -73.93, 40.82 in the northeast corner?
sql: WITH bbox AS (SELECT ST_MakeEnvelope(-74.02, 40.70, -73.93, 40.82) AS env) SELECT z.zone, z.borough FROM nyc_taxi_zones z, bbox WHERE ST_Within(z.geometry, bbox.env) ORDER BY z.zone

question: Show me the neighborhoods that touch or overlap the box around JFK Airport, roughly from -73.86, 40.62 to -73.75, 40.67, and include their map shapes so I can draw them.
sql: WITH bbox AS (SELECT ST_MakeEnvelope(-73.86, 40.62, -73.75, 40.67) AS env) SELECT z.zone, z.borough, ST_AsGeoJSON(z.geometry) AS shape FROM nyc_taxi_zones z, bbox WHERE ST_Intersects(z.geometry, bbox.env) ORDER BY z.zone

question: What is the overall bounding box that encloses all of the Brooklyn neighborhoods? I want the smallest rectangle that contains every Brooklyn area.
sql: SELECT ST_AsText(ST_Extent_Agg(geometry)) AS overall_bounding_box FROM nyc_taxi_zones WHERE borough = 'Brooklyn'

question: How many taxi rides in the sample started in a neighborhood whose center point falls inside the Lower Manhattan rectangle from -74.02, 40.70 to -73.99, 40.75?
sql: WITH bbox AS (SELECT ST_MakeEnvelope(-74.02, 40.70, -73.99, 40.75) AS env) SELECT COUNT(*) AS trip_count FROM nyc_taxi_trips t JOIN nyc_taxi_zones z ON t.PULocationID = z.location_id CROSS JOIN bbox WHERE z.geometry && bbox.env AND ST_Within(ST_Centroid(z.geometry), bbox.env)

question: Among the neighborhoods that intersect the big rectangle covering Brooklyn and western Queens from -74.05, 40.60 to -73.85, 40.75, which are the three largest by actual ground area in square kilometers?
sql: WITH bbox AS (SELECT ST_MakeEnvelope(-74.05, 40.60, -73.85, 40.75) AS env) SELECT z.zone, z.borough, ST_Area_Spheroid(z.geometry) / 1000000.0 AS area_sq_km FROM nyc_taxi_zones z, bbox WHERE ST_Intersects(z.geometry, bbox.env) ORDER BY area_sq_km DESC LIMIT 3

question: For taxi rides that ended inside the Midtown rectangle from -74.00, 40.74 to -73.95, 40.78, how many drop-offs came from each part of the city, ranked from most to least?
sql: WITH bbox AS (SELECT ST_MakeEnvelope(-74.00, 40.74, -73.95, 40.78) AS env) SELECT z.borough, COUNT(*) AS dropoff_count FROM nyc_taxi_trips t JOIN nyc_taxi_zones z ON t.DOLocationID = z.location_id CROSS JOIN bbox WHERE z.geometry && bbox.env AND ST_Intersects(z.geometry, bbox.env) GROUP BY z.borough ORDER BY dropoff_count DESC
